scripts.test: node -e "const http = require('http'); const tests = [{path:'/',expected:'Hello, World!'},{path:'/evening',expected:'Good evening'}]; let passed=0,failed=0; const runTest = (i) => { if(i >= tests.length) { console.log('Tests: ' + passed + '/' + tests.length + ' passed'); process.exit(failed > 0 ? 1 : 0); return; } const t = tests[i]; http.get('http://127.0.0.1:3000' + t.path, (res) => { let data = ''; res.on('data', c => data += c); res.on('end', () => { const actual = data.trim(); if(actual === t.expected) { console.log('PASS: GET ' + t.path + ' -> ' + actual); passed++; } else { console.log('FAIL: GET ' + t.path + ' -> Expected: ' + t.expected + ', Got: ' + actual); failed++; } runTest(i+1); }); }).on('error', (e) => { console.log('FAIL: GET ' + t.path + ' -> ' + e.message); failed++; runTest(i+1); }); }; runTest(0);"
